topic: Giving feedback that lands: how a manager gives a direct report specific, timely feedback on one piece of work, so it is heard and acted on rather than defended against

request.audience: new and mid-level people managers in a corporate office; adults, busy, sceptical of training videos
request.notes: Corporate L&D. Plain, mature, non-cartoony register: no dot-eye mascots, no glow. Presenter bookends only. Colleague voice, not teacher. Keep facts conservative: the method is a common practice (situation, behaviour, impact style), framed as practice, not as research claims.
